verdict: Single-pass is a good place to start for most documents. Agentic extraction may do better on exceptionally long or complex extractions, such as invoices or receipts with many line items. On [RealKIE](../idp-fundamentals/benchmark-datasets.md#realkie-fcc-verified) invoices with more than about 100 line items, single-pass got almost no line items right, and agentic with Claude Haiku 5.5 got 44% to 79%. Below that, single-pass scored as well or better, for about the same cost or less. Agentic costs here are a floor: we can't price its calls over 100,000 tokens, which Claude Haiku 5.5 charges more for. Test it on your own documents.
